# Spark

> Spark is a UK residential solar panel and battery storage installer covering mainland England, Wales and Scotland. Spark installs AIKO Neostar solar panels with EcoFlow PowerOcean battery storage, plus EV chargers and air-source heat pumps, and backs every install with a Triple Guarantee: a lifetime workmanship guarantee, a price match guarantee, and an EPVS-validated savings guarantee.

Key facts:
- Customers can cut energy bills by up to 90% with a full solar and battery system.
- Panels: AIKO Neostar 3S (485W), 30-year performance guarantee.
- Battery: EcoFlow PowerOcean, 15-year warranty, 5–20kWh storage options.
- Accreditations: Which? Trusted Trader, MCS Certified, TrustMark, NAPIT, HIES, EPVS.
- Rated 4.7/5 on Trustpilot from 420+ reviews.
- Head office: St Pegs Mill, Thornhills Beck Lane, Brighouse HD6 4AH, United Kingdom.
- Phone: 0330 818 7273. Email: hello@sparkhome.co.uk. Hours: Mon–Sat 09:00–18:00.
- For every install, Spark donates a solar panel to a UK school (Spark for Schools).
- Customers can sell surplus energy back to the grid via the Smart Export Guarantee (SEG).
